notes: ACCESS: no block. www.westelm.co.uk is a NetSuite SuiteCommerce Advanced storefront (COMPID 3572911) run by the Williams-Sonoma UK business; robots.txt (served as robots-we-uk.txt) names no Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot agent. A plain Googlebot UA returns fully prerendered server-side HTML for every category page (a desktop UA gets only the SPA shell); all 27 leaf URLs below were fetched that way and returned HTTP 200 with a breadcrumb that exactly matches the node claimed for them. r.jina.ai was Cloudflare-challenged (403) this session, so rendered headers were read directly in Chrome instead. TREE: recovered three ways that agree - the homepage mega-nav prerender, the category sitemap (/SitemapFiles/WEUK/sitemap-1787061731817-WEUK-category-0.xml, 511 URLs), and a full enumeration of the catalogue through the site's own Searchspring index (siteId mrb1uc), whose ss_hierarchy field carries every node path a product belongs to. QTY (Rule 1): the site's product grid is rendered by Searchspring, and the number it prints in the 'N products' listing header is pagination.totalResults for bgfilter.ss_hierarchy=<breadcrumb path>. I verified header==totalResults live in Chrome on 5 categories (Coffee Tables '37 products'=37, Chests of Drawers '27 products'=27, Coat & Shoe Racks '2 products'=2, Sofa Beds '10 products'=10, Garden Dining Furniture '10 products'=10). THAT HEADER IS INFLATED BY EXACTLY 1 on every category, because Searchspring counts one injected merchandising banner tile as a product. Re-proved three ways this session: (a) every one of the 27 nodes returns exactly one entry in merchandising.content.inline; (b) the Coat & Shoe Racks page prints '2 products' against a grid holding exactly 1 product tile, and the Chests of Drawers page prints '27 products' against exactly 26 unique product tile links; (c) a full catalogue enumeration returned 1,821 unique product ids against a reported total of 1,822. Per the project decision I recorded the LITERAL header number as qty, and every evidence string also states the real product count (header minus 1) so the orchestrator can switch. DE-DUPLICATION (uid sets compared, all confirmed IDENTICAL, one instance kept): 'Bookcases & Shelves' (18) is served at three URLs - Living Room, Home Office and Hallway - Living Room kept; 'Benches' (6) at Bedroom and Hallway - Bedroom kept; 'Console Tables & Entry Cabinets' (17) at Hallway and Living Room - Living Room kept; the whole /all-sofas department is a second face on Living Room seating (Sofas>Shop All>{Armchairs 49, Footstools & Ottomans 18, Sofas 31, Chaise & Corner Sofas 21, Sofa Beds 9} are byte-identical uid sets to the /furniture equivalents) so it contributes no rows, and its Shop By Material / Shop By Size children are colour-and-size filter re-cuts; Kids>Baby & Kids Furniture>{Kids Furniture 13, Nursery Furniture 19} are identical to the Furniture-department nodes kept here. HIERARCHY: Furniture>Living Room>Sofas has three real child listings with their own sitemap URLs (/sofas, /sectionals, /sofa-beds) whose uid sets partition the parent exactly (31+21+9 = 55 = parent), so Sofas is emitted as a grouping row and the three children as leaves. The leaf named 'Sofas' under the group named 'Sofas' is the site's own naming, not a duplicate. EXCLUDED and why: Mattresses (3, bedding not furniture); Bedroom Collections and its 8 range children (Andes, Ellington, Linwood, Mid-century, Miles, Penelope, Quinn, Solstice) and Garden Furniture Collections and its 5 children and /all-sofas Sofa Collections - marketing ranges, Rule 3; Furniture>Hallway>Wall Shelves & Hooks (6) - floating wall shelves, a wall rack and an entryway mirror, Wall Decor's job; Furniture Solutions > In-Stock & Ready-to-Ship Furniture (114) - an availability filter over furniture already counted; every Sale / Warehouse Sale / Clearance / New Arrivals node; Trade > Commercial Grade (All Furniture 294, Bedroom 55, Sofas & Armchairs 56) - a B2B audience re-cut of products already counted; Garden > Garden Parasols (1) and Garden Accessories & Decor, Garden Planters, Garden Dinnerware & Entertaining - not furniture. BATHROOM FURNITURE - deliberate exclusion, flagged here for the orchestrator: Bath > Bathroom Cabinets & Hardware has only two children and neither is a furniture node. 'Bathroom Hardware & Shelves' (15) is towel bars, hooks, rings, toilet-paper holders and floating wall shelves - fixtures, not furniture. 'Medicine Cabinets & Mirrors' (16) is a mixed roll-up whose primary product type is mirrors: I read all 16 titles - 10 are wall mirrors (already extracted under Art & Mirrors in the Wall Decor pass) against 6 bathroom/linen cabinets and 1 vanity. There is no split URL. Recording it would have put 10 mirrors into the furniture sheet, so it was dropped; if the project would rather have the 6 cabinets, the node is https://www.westelm.co.uk/bath/bathroom-cabinets-hardware/medicine-cabinets-mirrors and its literal header is 17. SANITY CHECKS: counts differ per category (no site-wide constant); no suspiciously round number; every breadcrumb read back from the fetched page matches the node; the Searchspring totals and the independent full-catalogue enumeration agree to the single banner tile on all 27 nodes; and the parent Furniture total (528 header / 527 real) is not used as any child's qty.
